name: Palak Paneer with Wholewheat Roti

components.name: Palak Paneer
steps: Wash spinach thoroughly, blanch in boiling water 1-2 minutes and immediately cool; drain and roughly blend with 170 ml water.
Heat oil in a saucepan and soften onion; add ginger and garlic for one minute.
Cook tomatoes and cumin until thick, then add blended spinach and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add paneer and garam masala; stir gently so cubes stay whole and cook for 5 minutes more.
Take off heat, stir in cream and taste salt; avoid extended boiling after adding dairy.

components.name: Wholewheat Roti

ingredients.name: Commercial plain wholewheat roti, eight pieces, purchased raw/pre-cooked as labelled

steps: Warm packaged roti according to its instructions and pack separately from palak paneer so bread stays pliable.
